title: Now & Then
description: Where I've been, what I've made, and what I'm up to now.
indexTitle: Where I've Been. Where I'm Going.

chapters.heading: Now
chapters.label: Now
blocks: Two things, currently: I'm in the middle of moving to Lisbon. And I'm developing a travel series called OutroSpective — asking interesting people the questions we can't stop asking ourselves. Over breakfast. In incredible places.

chapters.label: 2021 · Turkey → LA
blocks: Turkey to Los Angeles. Filmed How to Meet People — the first real swing at the format: point a camera at the questions everyone's too polite to ask out loud.

chapters.heading: East Hampton
chapters.label: East Hampton
blocks: The East Hampton years — Breakfast Club vibes, a house full of people asking each other good questions before 9am. With a smattering of travels stitched through it: Amsterdam, London, Maastricht.

chapters.label: 2022 · BITN, INC
blocks: Filmed and cut the rough of BITN, INC.

chapters.label: 2023 · How to Life
blocks: How to Life, the docu-series. Teaser cut, episodes in motion.

chapters.label: 2025 · The Quiet Build
blocks: A chiller, more tranquil chapter — on purpose. The focus was Good Couch: building the thing, doing the work, landing real clients (including the Colorado Department of Public Health & Environment).
Not every year needs a montage. Some years are the foundation the montage sits on.

chapters.label: 2026 · A Bunch of Places
blocks: The year the map got big. Rotterdam. Paris. Biarritz. Istanbul. Japan with my parents — Kyoto, Osaka, Kobe. A fall down a staircase in Istanbul airport that became its own essay.
I'm also building Yellow Satin Jacket.

end.title: That's the story so far.
end.shareBody:
Thought of you — a timeline of adventures from Michael Kilcoyne.
